reasons.reason: One real solution means the quadratic is a perfect square, and for that to happen the middle coefficient has to line up with the constant term of 9, so k must equal 9.
Exactly one real solution needs a zero discriminant, so k squared minus four times nine must be zero. That makes k squared equal to 36, and the positive value is 6.
